paper.title_en: The first-order phase transitions and gravitational waves from an effective theory inspired by four-stack intersecting D6-brane models
paper.abstract_en: First-order phase transitions in the early Universe can generate stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds in frequency bands targeted by proposed deci-Hz observatories. We study the gravitational-wave consequences of the right-handed gauge symmetry breaking $SU(2)_{R_1}\times SU(2)_{R_2}\to SU(2)_R$ in a Pati-Salam effective theory inspired by four-stack intersecting D6-brane models. The ultraviolet construction fixes the gauge structure and particle multiplicities, while the scalar masses and quartic couplings are treated as renormalized inputs below the supersymmetry-breaking scale. Using a one-loop finite-temperature potential with ring resummation, we follow a strongly supercooled transition at the few-TeV scale through nucleation, percolation, completion, and reheating. The leading-order friction diagnostic does not support a runaway wall, so sound waves dominate the gravitational-wave signal, with turbulence as a sub-leading contribution; the finite acoustic lifetime suppresses the peak. For the fast-wall reference case, the spectrum peaks at $f_{\rm peak}=0.611$ Hz with $h^2Ω_{\rm GW,peak}=1.232\times10^{-11}$, in the deci-Hz band targeted by DECIGO and BBO. We present its dependence on the wall speed, renormalization scale, and thermal screening, together with a noise-only comparison for several proposed detector configurations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文基于四叠相交D6膜构造启发的Pati-Salam有效理论，系统计算右手规范对称性破缺所致强过冷一级相变的随机引力波谱，采用含环重求和的一圈有限温度有效势，详细追踪成核、渗流、完成与重加热过程，并给出峰值频率与振幅对壁速、重整化标度与热屏蔽的依赖及探测器噪声比较，理论建模与数值分析较为完整，与早期宇宙相变引力波这一主题高度相关，值得点击阅读全文。
decision.title_zh: 四叠相交D6膜模型启发的有效理论中的一阶相变与引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 早期宇宙中的一阶相变可产生随机引力波背景，其频段正好落在所提议的十分之一赫兹（deci-Hz）观测器的目标范围内。我们研究了受四叠相交D6膜模型启发的Pati-Salam有效理论中右手规范对称性破缺 $SU(2)_{R_1}\times SU(2)_{R_2}\to SU(2)_R$ 的引力波后果。紫外构造固定了规范结构和粒子多重数，而标量质量和四次耦合被视为超对称破缺标度以下的重整化输入。使用含环重求和的一圈有限温度有效势，我们追踪了在几个TeV标度上的强过冷相变，历经成核、渗流、完成与重加热过程。领头阶摩擦判据不支持跑动壁（runaway wall），因此声波主导引力波信号，湍流作为次领头贡献；有限声学寿命抑制了峰值。对于快壁参考情形，谱峰位于 $f_{\rm peak}=0.611$ Hz，$h^2Ω_{\rm GW,peak}=1.232\times10^{-11}$，处于DECIGO和BBO所瞄准的deci-Hz频段。我们给出了谱对壁速、重整化标度和热屏蔽的依赖关系，并针对若干所提议的探测器配置进行了仅含噪声的比较。
